info.title: API.SH: Vimeo
info.description: The Vimeo API from API.SH: public Vimeo data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Search Vimeo videos. Each result has the video fields of /vimeo/v1/video (without streams) and `staff_pick`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Narrow by `category`, `uploaded` (last week, month or year), Creative Commons `license` and `staff_picks`; `filters` echoes the choices.

`type` switches to the site's other search tabs: `user` (creators: name, link, location and bio as shown, account type, join date, avatar, video and follower counts), `channel` or `group` (name, link, description, dates, picture, owner, member and video counts; groups also who may view and join). The video filters apply to type=video only.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vimeo-search

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: What to search (video, user, channel, group; default video).

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Length filter: short (<4 min), medium (4-20 min), long (>20 min).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Only videos in this category (category slug), e.g. `animation`, `documentary`, `travel`, `music`.

parameters.name: uploaded
parameters.description: Only videos uploaded within this period.

parameters.name: license
parameters.description: Only videos under this Creative Commons license.

parameters.name: staff_picks
parameters.description: Set to `1` for Vimeo Staff Picks only.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A public Vimeo profile. For a user or brand: name, bio, location, account type, verified badge, available for hire, join date, avatar, websites, skills and counts of videos, followers, following, likes, albums, channels, groups and appearances. For a channel: name, description, owner, tags, categories, privacy, picture, header, followers and videos. Use /vimeo/v1/user/videos for a user's videos. Includes `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vimeo-user

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Vimeo username or profile URL (vimeo.com/<user>). Give this, `channel` or `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A vimeo.com profile or channel link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vimeo-video

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
